parties.respondent: Securities and Exchange Board of India & Ors.

summary: SEBI asset liquidation delay; multiple FIRs across states under Prize Chits Act and IPC; Petitioners seek time-bound liquidation of assets worth Rs. 3056 Crores for investor refunds; complex multi-state property issues (encumbrances, titles, taxes); SEBI/EOW audit confirms liability Rs. 4700 crores vs initial Rs. 3049 crores; interim bail orders for Petitioner No.3; court directs SEBI to formulate liquidation mechanism considering location, encumbrances, title disputes, valuation, statutory dues, and local laws.
legal_provisions_cited: Prize Chits and Money Circulation Scheme (Banning) Act, 1978 s.3, s.4, s.5, s.6, s.10
final_judgment: Court directed SEBI to frame a comprehensive mechanism for time-bound liquidation of attached assets after considering all legal and procedural complexities; Petitioners' request for direct liquidation order partially granted with procedural directions.
